summary: Tested all new gamification APIs and frontend components. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend components (ScratchCard, StreakShield, PredictionStreak) render correctly on Rewards page.

POST /api/games/scratch-card/scratch - Correctly rejects when no episode watched (400 error)
GET /api/games/streak/shield/status - Returns has_shield, shield_cost=50, can_afford, current_coins
POST /api/games/streak/shield - Correctly validates insufficient coins and duplicate purchase
POST /api/games/prediction/submit - Correctly rejects duplicate prediction (400 error)
GET /api/games/trivia/{episode_id} - Correctly rejects for unwatched episode (400 error)
Prediction streak route correctly ordered before parametric /{episode_id} route
ScratchCard component renders on Rewards page with locked state
StreakShield component renders with 50 coin cost button
PredictionStreak component renders showing 0 correct streak
